enemies._newMonsters: 2026-11-11: 25 animated CC0 monsters (Quaternius, via poly.pizza; assets/models/monsters). model = the .glb, h = height in metres, lift = how far fliers hover, tint = colour over the model.

mimic._note: Breakables.cs surprise: a crate or chest that bites (the golemling body)

enemies._animals: A-21 wildlife (2026-11-27): proc = procedural body in data/creatures.json, h = height of the head in metres. flee = runs away; neutral = fights only when struck; neither = hunts you (aggro). livestock = farm animal (ranching). fly = bird / bat circling at flyAlt m (flee: climbs away; with dmg: swoops). time = day | night. sound + pitch = the call when startled (an existing Sfx id). Herds and biomes: data/wildlife.json "animals".

bandit._ds: Dark Souls pass: poise (hits before it staggers), poiseDmg (its blow on the hero's poise), windPause (held top of the wind-up, s): game.poise / game.enemyAtk
